tools.description: Compute workflow metrics, velocity, burndown, cognitive load, decision lineages, and contradiction audits. Supported actions: summary (project overview), velocity (throughput and duration), burndown (time-series remaining tasks chart), value_metrics (token savings and ROI), cognitive_load (ICL and ECL context complexity), critical_path (longest unfinished task chain), context_snapshot / active_context (consolidated overview), decision_trail (trace decision lineage), find_related_decisions (find decisions related to an artifact), contradictions (audit for conflicting decisions or broken states).

action.description: The analytics or decision analysis action to execute.

days.description: Number of historical days for burndown (default: 14).

window_days.description: Number of days to analyze for velocity (default: 14).

tools.name: get_analytics

tools.description: Inspect the append-only event audit ledger, query structured changesets, and generate session post-mortems. Supported actions: log (query event ledger with filters), changelog (get structured graph diff since timestamp or session), post_mortem (analyze a session and produce a structured markdown report).

action.description: The event query action to execute.

session_id.description: Session ID for log or post_mortem.

since.description: ISO timestamp or relative duration (e.g. 2h, 1d) for log or changelog.

since_session.description: Session ID to diff from for changelog.

tools.name: get_events

tools.description: Export and import graph structures, issue tracker items, fine-tuning trajectories, and multimodal synergy metrics. Supported actions: export_graph (export to JSON/DOT/Mermaid/HTML), export_issues (export to GitHub/Jira JSON), export_trajectories (export JSONL fine-tuning data), export_joint_trajectories (export interleaved state + vision data), export_synergy_metrics (compute dual-memory metrics), import_graph (bulk import nodes & edges), import_issues (import GitHub/Jira issues), import_spec (import PRD/Gherkin spec).

action.description: The data export or import action to execute.

edges.description: Array of edge objects for import_graph.

issues.description: Array of issue objects for import_issues.

nodes.description: Array of node objects for import_graph.

tools.name: manage_data

tools.description: Physical SQLite database maintenance, backups, integrity checks, and Git VCS state sync. Supported actions: backup (online SQLite backup), restore (destructive restore from backup), audit (foreign keys and physical integrity check), merge (merge external SQLite state DB), branch_diff (diff state nodes across git branches), branch_merge (resolve graph conflicts during branch merge).

action.description: The database administration or VCS sync action to execute.

backupPath.description: Source backup file path for restore.

force.description: Force overwrite during restore or merge.

outputPath.description: Target destination file path for backup.

sourcePath.description: Source SQLite database path for merge.

target_branch.description: Target git branch to compare or merge against.

tools.name: manage_database

tools.description: Manage typed graph relationships between nodes. Supported actions: add (create typed relationship), remove (delete relationship), batch_add (create multiple relationships atomically), link_visual (link task or artifact to visual memory state).

action.description: The edge management action to execute.

edges.description: Array of edge objects for batch_add.

properties.description: Optional metadata properties for the edge.

relationship.description: Relationship type for link_visual (e.g. renders_state, blocked_by_visual_state).

source_url.description: Optional URL where the visual state was captured.

visual_description.description: Optional text description for the visual state.

visual_state_id.description: Visual Memory snapshot/state ID for link_visual.

tools.name: manage_edges

tools.description: Manage graph nodes in the state graph. Supported actions: create (add single node), update (modify node properties), get (fetch node with edges), remove (delete node and cascade edges), list (filter nodes), search (FTS5 or TF-IDF search), batch_create (create multiple nodes atomically), batch_update (update multiple nodes atomically), add_note (log observation node with optional context link).

action.description: The node management action to execute.

attach_to.description: Node ID to attach observation note to via references edge.

compact.description: Whether to return a lightweight compact summary.

expected_version.description: Optimistic concurrency version check for update.

id.description: Unique node identifier for get, update, or remove.

ids.description: Array of node IDs for batch_update.

include_edges.description: Whether to include inbound/outbound edges on get.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (1-1000).

nodes.description: Array of node payloads for batch_create.

offset.description: Number of items to skip for pagination.

session_id.description: Active session identifier for change attribution.

status.description: Status of the node (e.g. pending, in_progress, done, blocked, active, accepted, current).

title.description: Title or label of the node.

type.description: The type classification of the node.

tools.name: manage_nodes

tools.description: Manage agent tracking sessions and multi-turn workflow attribution. Supported actions: start (begin tracked session), end (conclude session), list (view active/historical sessions), bootstrap (single-turn start + context snapshot + next tasks).

action.description: The session management action to execute.

active_only.description: Whether to return only active unclosed sessions on list.

agent_id.description: Agent identifier for session tracking and change attribution.

limit.description: Maximum number of sessions to list (1-1000).

task_limit.description: Maximum runnable tasks to return on bootstrap.

tools.name: manage_sessions

tools.description: State checkpointing, time travel, diffing, and undo operations. Supported actions: save (create named checkpoint), list (list checkpoints), diff (compare two snapshots), get_state (reconstruct graph state at historical timestamp), revert (rollback graph to historical timestamp), undo (revert last mutation on a node), get_history (chronological audit log for a node).

action.description: The snapshot management action to execute.

force.description: Force snapshot even if node count is high.

node_id.description: Node ID for undo or get_history.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for get_state or revert.

tools.name: manage_snapshots

tools.description: Spec-Driven Development (SDD) lifecycle and workflow template generation. Supported actions: scaffold (generate spec template in .specs/), ingest (parse PRD/Gherkin into graph nodes), export (export spec node back to Markdown/Gherkin), compliance (calculate requirement coverage matrix), verify (mark acceptance criterion verified/failing), decompose_feature (decompose feature into plan/milestones/subtasks), template (scaffold FDD or RFC template).

action.description: The specification or template action to execute.

criterion_id.description: Acceptance criterion node ID for verify.

file_path.description: File path of PRD or Gherkin feature for ingest.

observation_id.description: Optional observation node ID containing test proof.

subtasks.description: Array of subtask titles for decompose_feature.

title.description: Title of feature spec or template.

tools.name: manage_specs

tools.description: Task prioritization, workflow execution, blockers, and stale task management. Supported actions: next (query prioritized unblocked tasks), complete (mark done and optionally create artifact), find_blocked (find tasks blocked by a decision), find_stale (find idle/untouched tasks), find_blockers (find active blockers), find_similar_blockers (TF-IDF search for previously resolved blockers), auto_prune (cancel stale in-progress tasks).

action.description: The task management action to execute.

artifact_file_path.description: Optional file path for produced artifact.

artifact_title.description: Optional title of artifact produced on complete.

include_context.description: Whether to include parent plan/milestone and blocker context on next.

node_id.description: Optional node ID to check blockers for.

target_status.description: Target status to assign when auto-pruning (e.g. cancelled).

visual_state_id.description: Optional visual state ID to link on complete.

tools.name: manage_tasks

tools.description: Query graph topology, neighborhoods, dependency paths, and safe read-only SQL queries. Supported actions: subgraph (fetch N-hop neighborhood around root node), trace (trace dependency chain upstream or downstream with cycle detection), raw (execute safe read-only SELECT query against SQLite), natural_language (translate natural language query into graph operations).

action.description: The graph query action to execute.

direction.description: Direction of dependency traversal for trace.

edge_types.description: Allowed edge types for trace (default: depends_on, blocks, child_of).

query.description: Natural language search query for natural_language action.

root_id.description: Root node ID for subgraph query.

sql.description: Read-only SELECT query for raw action.

tools.name: query_graph

tools.description: Run graph sanity checks, health diagnostics, reference validation, audit chain verification, and storage maintenance. Supported actions: validate (check cycles, orphans, dangling edges), doctor (database WAL mode, schema version, storage health), check_refs (validate file paths and AST symbols with auto-heal), audit_chain (verify SHA-256 event hash integrity), compact (reclaim SQLite storage), archive (archive old completed tasks), prune_events (permanently prune events - admin mode required), version (retrieve package version info), dedupe (detect and merge duplicate nodes).

action.description: The diagnostic or maintenance action to execute.

apply.description: For dedupe action: whether to apply merging (default: false for dry-run).

auto_heal.description: Automatically fix broken file references on check_refs.

older_than_days.description: Age threshold in days for archive (default: 30).

preserve_types.description: Event types to preserve from pruning.

prune_orphaned_edges.description: Whether to prune dangling edges during compact.

tools.name: run_diagnostics

tools.description: Multi-agent shared blackboard for asynchronous coordination. Actions: get (read notices or fetch by id), set (post notice with TTL), delete (remove by id or topic), lease (acquire or release mutex), list (list active topics). Legacy post/read supported.

agent_role.description: Sender agent role (e.g. planner, coder, reviewer).

id.description: Blackboard entry identifier for get or delete.

limit.description: Maximum number of items or topics to return.

mode.description: Lease action mode: acquire or release (default: acquire).

resource_id.description: Resource identifier to lease or release.

tools.name: use_blackboard
